scene: Inside the humming mill, giant rollers press wet pulp into parchment.
picture: Side-view pixel art of a mill interior. On the far left, a steaming wooden vat holds wet paper pulp. Left of centre, the elderly East Asian player in cap and cardigan leans on his cane. Centre, large steel rollers flank a brass wheel valve. Far right, a wooden ladder leads up to a catwalk.
shown: A steaming wooden vat of blue-tinted paper pulp on the far left.
A gleaming brass wheel valve mounted on pipes in the centre.
A sturdy wooden ladder leading to an elevated gantry on the far right.

variants.scene: Steam rises from bubbly blue pulp while heavy iron rollers press smooth sheets.
The warm factory clatters softly as fresh paper squeezes through the big press.
You smell damp wood and hear gears whirring while you seek {quest}.
